name: @CameliaGirls
source:
A simple slice-of-life Visual Novel from the point of a view of a computer-savvy transfer student at the Camelia All-Girls Academy. Will she discover friendship and collaboration that transcends and unites the real and digital worlds? Or will she spend most of her time battling with a wacky teacher and an even more colorful assortment of crazy roommates?

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/cameliagirls.shtml]Ren'ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
這是一部簡單的日常系視覺小說，以一名精通電腦、剛轉入山茶花女子學園的學生為視角。她會發現跨越現實與數位世界、將二者聯結起來的友誼與協作嗎？還是會把大部分時間花在應付古怪的老師和一群個性更加古怪的瘋狂室友上？

[出自[url=http://renai.us/game/cameliagirls.shtml]Ren'ai Archive[/url]]
